# Dylan Norquist

> Personal site of Dylan Norquist, Researcher at DreamcatcherAI. Notes on
> machine learning, software, papers, and side projects. Opinions are personal
> and unaffiliated with employer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dylannorquist.codes/): Short bio and intro.
- [Projects](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects): Index of side projects.
- [Resume](https://dylannorquist.codes/resume): Background, experience, and education.

## Projects

- [SMEARGLE](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects/smeargle): Model-based speculative decoding that surpasses the previous SOTA (EAGLE3).
- [Grimoire](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects/grimoire): A coding-agent CLI built with Textual, compatible with a Claude subscription.
- [Fusion](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects/fusion): A programming language with an LSP and VSCode extension, capable of training a microGPT.
- [Gradtuity](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects/gradtuity): A from-scratch tensor autograd engine using Triton GPU kernels.
- [Neural Network from Scratch](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects/neural-network-from-scratch): A 28x28 grayscale digit recognizer written from scratch in C++.
- [Weather App](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects/weather-app): A KATA problem from Direct Supply.
- [3D Game Engine](https://dylannorquist.codes/projects/3d-game-engine): An in-progress 3D game engine, currently swapping its render backend.
